description: Interactive Digital Aquarium Experience [Draw a Fish](https://drawafish.live) is an interactive web-based platform that allows users to bring their artistic creations to life in a shared digital environment. By utilizing real-time drawing tools, users can sketch unique aquatic creatures and watch them join a global tank where they interact with other users' designs.
